## Grap applications data

We are now interested in testing whether there is a relationship between the *rank* of a student's undergraduate institution (1 = most selective, 4 = least selective) and their acceptance to a graduate program, after accounting for GRE score and undergraduate GPA.

We fit the regression model

$$Admit_i \sim Bernoulli(\pi_i)$$

$$\log \left( \dfrac{\pi_i}{1 - \pi_i} \right) = \beta_0 + \beta_1 GPA_i + \beta_2 GRE_i + \beta_3 Rank2_i + \beta_4 Rank3_i + \beta_5 Rank4_i$$

### Questions

1. Write down the null and alternative hypotheses corresponding to the research question.

\vspace{3cm}

2. Write down the reduced model.

\vspace{3cm}

3. Below is output for the fitted models. Calculate an appropriate test statistic to test the hypotheses in question 1. What will be the degrees of freedom for the $\chi^2$ distribution under $H_0$?

\vspace{3cm}

```{r, echo=F}
grad_app <- read.csv("https://stats.idre.ucla.edu/stat/data/binary.csv")
glm(admit ~ gpa + gre + factor(rank), family = binomial, data = grad_app)
glm(admit ~ gpa + gre, family = binomial, data = grad_app)
```
